method.actionable: Impact, applicability and recommendation must all be supported. Validation is separate; no weighted score or implementation pass.
method.validation: Full SK1 requires real Redis/worker, persisted job ID, completed export, exact ordered Markdown bytes, and rejection queue/row state. method.raw_source: background_planner_report is null in every file. Raw is the main_tool_trace Agent result for maintain-rails:gem-upgrade-planner, including ALL authored introductions and parent-like closing notes, not just its inner report.
method.wrapper_handling: Excluded native [Subagent hand-back] wrapper and agentId/usage metadata; removed exactly the native two-space wrapper indentation. No authored indentation, wording or parent-like claims were silently normalized away.
method.comparison: Read all raw and final reports and compared normalized lines. Runs 1/4 preserve the full authored report verbatim inside a new introduction/closing. Runs 2/5 retain the central plan with local intro/context edits and replace authored closing notes. Run 3 rewrites wording throughout without losing selected substance; it is not literal central-plan byte identity.
method.extra_risks: Eight independent risk categories are recorded per run with layers identified. These never enlarge the two-family denominator. Portable array SADD with positive? or ==1, call('SADD',...)==1, and explicit acceptance of true or 1 are valid for the two clients. Run 5's native authored closing explicitly selects the latter and rejects unfinished alternatives, so that clarification belongs to raw, not independent parent discovery.
evidence_limits: Nested experiment logs/scripts are not collected here. Authored reports, filenames and parent-like spot-check claims are model output, not independent observations.

Actual main-agent Bash excerpts exist in runs 2 and 5: run 2 collects pool3 pop errors and a zero error-match count for the pinned log; run 5 collects baseline/target suite summaries, symbol rejection, SADD 1/0 and BigDecimal rejection. These prove only the quoted observations, not all reported experiments.

Main-agent git status is clean in runs 1, 2 and 5 at the observed instant. Runs 3/4 have no post-planner preservation check. No clean status proves full filesystem, service, database or environment preservation.
Run 4 honestly reports no experiments. Runs 1/2/3/5 report disposable copies and cleanup, but service/database cleanup is not independently collected.
No production performance, full queue-family compatibility, simultaneous mixed fleet or in-flight shutdown proof. Five plans do not establish reliability.
